question: Run the pytest test class `optuna_qa/wilcoxon_prune_m1_cfg/files/testcase.py::TestWilcoxonPruneScenarios` (all of its test methods, i.e. every pytest id of the form `optuna_qa/wilcoxon_prune_m1_cfg/files/testcase.py::TestWilcoxonPruneScenarios::test_*`) in the repository as checked out. Answer as a JSON object with exactly one key `line_execution_counts`, whose value is a list of objects with exactly the keys `line` (int, absolute 1-based line number in `optuna/pruners/_wilcoxon.py`) and `count` (int, >= 0).
